description: Get recent solar flare events from NASA DONKI space-weather data. Returns each flare's class (e.g. C4.0, M1.8, X1.2), begin/peak/end times, source region, and active region number. Use for "recent solar flares", "is there solar activity / a solar storm", space-weather questions.

_apiKey.description: NASA API key (optional, defaults to DEMO_KEY)

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; default ~30 days ago).

name: get_solar_flares
title: Get Solar Flares
